subject: Demo staging, crate checklist and visibility request
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie@eventspaceco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Converge '27 — booth space options and shipping constraints

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for confirming Redwood's participation at Converge '27. Attached are the floorplan options for Hall B (PDF: floorplan_options_Converge27.pdf) and the venue shipping spec sheet (shipping_spec_sheet.pdf).

Quick highlights you should know:
- We have three remaining 20x20 footprints: corner near the main aisle (best sightlines), a mid-row 20x20, and a near-stage 15x20 (reduced headroom).
- Power risers are fixed in the locations marked on the floorplan; islands may require an approved cable cover plan.
- Freight elevator max pallet size: 48" x 42" x 84" — anything larger will need crating and tailgate service.
- Loading dock window for Redwood's move-in is currently provisionally booked for Tue 09:00–12:00; we can adjust if you need an earlier slot.

If you can confirm preferred footprint by EOD Monday, I can tentatively hold the corner 20x20 for you for 48 hours. Also attaching the venue's crate/labeling requirements in the spec sheet.

Cheers,
Jamie Park
Senior Sales Partner
EventSpace Co.
attachments: [floorplan_options_Converge27.pdf, shipping_spec_sheet.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@eventspaceco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converge '27 — booth space options and shipping constraints

Thanks Jamie — the floorplans look good. A few asks so we can finalize: 

1) Please tentatively hold the corner 20x20 (best sightlines) for Redwood until Wed EOB; we'll confirm by then.
2) Can you confirm the exact coordinates of the power riser nearest the corner footprint? We need to validate demo staging and monitor riser locations against the power map.
3) We need the venue's explicit crate labeling format and whether empty crate storage during the show is charged. If the spec sheet doesn't call it out, can you get that from venue ops?

Internal note for Marissa/Tessa/Mateo: we should assume a demo station with two laptops, one 40" monitor, and a locked demo kiosk (approx crate dims 48x40x60). I'm attaching the draft crate checklist and the demo station drawing so we can confirm final packing and carrier instructions.

Attachments: [exhibit_crate_checklist_v2.xlsx, demo_station_drawing_v3.pdf]

Proposed next steps: 
- Jamie: confirm riser coordinates and storage policy.
- Marissa: confirm whether we want a raised demo riser or a flush floor layout (decision required by Wed).
- Mateo/Tessa: estimate crate count and confirm any special hardware that requires foam inserts.

Irene Choi
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0172

From: Event Courier <logistics@eventcourier.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Crate dimensions & quote for Converge '27

Hi Irene — thanks for the details. Quoting based on the assumed crate dims (48x40x60) and an initial estimate of 3 crates plus one demo kiosk crate:

- Pickup from Redwood HQ (SF) to Converge venue: $1,180 (includes tailgate, one install crew, and forklift time).
- Overnight storage of empty crates during show: $220/day (we can arrange off-site bonded storage for lower daily rates if needed).
- Insurance for demo equipment (up to $50k): $95 flat.

Attached: vendor_quote_EventCourier_0427.pdf. We can confirm exact pricing once you finalize total crate count and whether any crate exceeds the freight elevator dimensions.

Available pickup windows next week: Tue 05/18 06:00–10:00 OR Wed 05/19 16:00–20:00. Please confirm preferred window and whether you need white-glove uncrating on show day.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Operations Manager
Event Courier
attachments: [vendor_quote_EventCourier_0427.pdf]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-12T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Converge '27 — approvals and action items (finalize by Wed)

Quick internal sync: 

- Jamie will hold corner 20x20 until Wed EOB. We should lock that footprint.
- Venue ops confirmed the power riser is ~6ft from the corner post (per Jamie's follow-up). That works for our planned monitor placement but will push the power cable run across the carpet — Mateo please confirm if cable ramps required.
- Event Courier quote looks within budget; they offered Tue 05/18 morning pickup or Wed 05/19 evening. I recommend Tue morning to give us buffer for crate damage checks.
- Marissa: decide on raised riser (adds show presence) vs flush layout. If riser, we need to change crate foam spec.

Please upload final riser decision and the signed DocuSign (link below) by Wed 12:00 PDT so I can firm the pickup slot.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDE3-example
DocuSign: DocuSign: 0A9F-23B

Thanks — I will confirm with Jamie once you approve.

Irene Choi
Senior Events Manager
Redwood Inference
